title: Indian Rupee Surges Against US Dollar: Oil Prices Fall, Foreign Investors Return | Vantage on Firstp
description:
The Indian rupee has hit a seven-month high against the US dollar, gaining over 90 paise in just three trading sessions. The currency opened at ₹93.30 against the dollar on November 18, 2026, extending its rally for a third consecutive day.
Falling crude oil prices, renewed foreign portfolio investor (FPI) inflows into Indian equities and improved market sentiment are driving the rupee's recovery. Brent crude has eased towards $92 a barrel, offering relief to India's import bill and inflation outlook.
Meanwhile, the currency forwards market is signalling greater optimism about the rupee than currency forecasters, with bullish bets rising. Can the rupee sustain its rally? What is driving foreign investors back to Indian markets? And could the dollar-rupee exchange rate fall further? Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
